title: When parsing a report descriptor, Collection doesn't take the usages' page
body:
In section 6, under "To parse the report descriptor, run the following steps:", under "If item has the [Collection tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-collection-tag):", the spec has the following steps:

> 1. Let collection be a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [HIDCollectionInfo](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo) dictionary.
> 2. Let usage be the first [item](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item) of usages.
> 3. If the [size](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size) of usages is greater than 1, remove the first [item](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item) of usages.
> 4. Set collection["[usagePage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo-usagepage)"] to globalState["[usagePage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo-usagepage)"].
> 5. Set collection["[usage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo-usage)"] to usage.

However, when we insert items into `usages`, we do the following steps (under "If item is a [Local item](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-local-items):"):
> 1. Let value be the [item data field](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-item-data-field) interpreted as an unsigned long.
> 2. If item has the [Usage tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-usage-tag):
>    1. If item's [bSize field](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-bsize-field) is 1 or 2:
>        1. Let usageId be an unsigned short containing the lower 16 bits of value.
>        2. Let globalState be the last [item](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item) of globalStack.
>        3. Set value to a [HID usage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-hid-usages) composed of globalState["[usagePage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo-usagepage)"] in the high order bits and usageId in the low order bits.
>    2. [Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) value to usages.

So the items in `usages` already have their `usagePage` stored in the high order bits. (whether through the packing done here or implicitly if it's a 4-byte extended value)

---

I think the Collection tag part should look something like this:

> 1. Let collection be a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [HIDCollectionInfo](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo) dictionary.
> 2. Let usage be the first [item](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item) of usages.
> 3. If the [size](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size) of usages is greater than 1, remove the first [item](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item) of usages.
> 4. Set collection["[usagePage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo-usagepage)"] to the high order bits of usage.
> 5. Set collection["[usage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo-usage)"] to the low order bits of usage.
